invariants: provenance identity is SHA-256 over canonical semantic material only
candidate identity must agree with exact-input binding and deep-assurance plan candidate head
deep assurance must be satisfied with status PASS or NOT_REQUIRED
deep-assurance verdict must bind the exact plan identity supplied to provenance
producing workflow repository is canonical and workflow SHA equals candidate head
workflow path ref run id and run attempt are explicit provenance identity
domain integrity digests are preserved as separate sorted references and never replaced by provenance identity
attestation subject SHA-256 equals provenance envelope identity rather than any domain digest
timestamps producer URLs notes and transport metadata never alter provenance identity
duplicate unsafe malformed or tampered domain references fail closed
provenance validation requires no paid service or mandatory LLM
